description: Customer support ticket routing: account, billing, shipping, orders, refunds, and more

label_descriptions.account: Signup problems, profile edits, recovering a profile PIN, and switching account tier. Also covers updating stored contact fields such as email, phone or address on the account
label_descriptions.cancel: Cancellation FEES and early-termination penalties only. Not requests to cancel something. 'Cancel my order' belongs to order, 'cancel my subscription' to subscription
label_descriptions.contact: Reaching a human agent: support hours, support email or phone, escalation to an operator
label_descriptions.delivery: Delivery timing and shipping methods: when an order will arrive, how long shipping takes, which shipping options exist, and what shipping costs. Order tracking lands here too
label_descriptions.feedback: Complaints, reviews, and formal customer claims against the company
label_descriptions.invoice: Finding or retrieving a specific invoice or bill, usually by number or by date
label_descriptions.order: Placing an order, adding or removing items from an existing order, and order status
label_descriptions.payment: Payment errors and which payment methods are accepted
label_descriptions.refund: Refund status, refund policy, and requests to get money back
label_descriptions.shipping: Editing or updating the delivery ADDRESS only. Nothing else about shipping: options, cost and timing all belong to delivery
label_descriptions.subscription: The company NEWSLETTER, subscribing and unsubscribing. Not paid plans or paid subscriptions
